All Fridges are Psychotic is out now - help Julius enter his script in the competition, with the assistance of Gustav, the time travelling fridge.

With a 15% Launch Discount (until Friday 17th of January) grab your copy now!

notes.title: All Fridges Demo Update - Hint System
notes.notes:
Taking on some great feedback from our players, this [b]All Fridges Are Psychotic [/b]update fixes a number of GUI issues, but also adds a little help for players!

With this release, right-clicking will give a short-duration highlighting of objects that you can interact with in the current scene - so if you're really stuck, this will give you a bit a pointer.

Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44983889/a57de93e4fb0eda0e80d948fa9b2c6070a5b0aad.jpg[/img]

notes.title: All Fridges Are Psychotic - Demo OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
After a long wait, All Fridges Are Psychotic is now available to play.

The demo is the first 3 scenes from the main game, where Julius has to try to escape his flat. 

Give it a try - feedback is very welcome!
